verdict.rationale: Groq offers an OpenAI-compatible REST API with extensive documented endpoints (chat completions, tool use, structured outputs, batch, streaming, responses API) and official client SDKs (e.g. groq-typescript), confirmed by both docs and live probes returning HTTP 200. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s), so machine-readable API schema isn't confirmed.
